previous_statement: Every Q in T_0 has d_Q=0. Adding the disjoint T_- and T_+ bounds therefore gives sum_{Q in T}|d_Q| <= (K_C+1)*delta+(K_C+K_R+1)*delta/4 = B*delta.
new_statement: If sum_{Q in T_-}|d_Q| <= (K_C+1)*delta and sum_{Q in T_+}|d_Q| <= (K_C+K_R+1)*delta/4, then, because T_-, T_+, T_0 are disjoint and every Q in T_0 has d_Q=0, one has sum_{Q in T}|d_Q| <= (K_C+1)*delta+(K_C+K_R+1)*delta/4 = B*delta.
